scope: focused controller acquisition, recovery, generation, hedge, readiness-barrier, compatibility, and cleanup tests only
full_repository_test_suite_reason: Explicitly prohibited by the Attempt 006 mission.

test_runs.name: existing E025 focused compatibility regressions
test_runs.command: $env:PYTHONPATH=(Resolve-Path src).Path; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_experiment_025.py::{eight named focused tests}
test_runs.execution_note: Run outside the filesystem sandbox because PyTorch c10.dll was denied inside it; no network/provider operation was performed.

final_combined_verification.scope: all 13 new Attempt 006 acquisition tests plus the eight named existing E025 compatibility regressions in one final run

parent_concurrency.assertion: Parent creation starts from four public fragment mappings before fragment WORKER_READY; replacement increments the endpoint generation and replaces a stale parent with exactly the current four endpoints.

ready_churn.assertion: A lost READY worker leaves the current registry, only its group is replaced, and unrelated healthy groups remain retained.

dynamic_alternates.assertion: A fresh exact-constraint query is audited; active, failed, and incompatible offers or machines cannot be selected.

reliability_scoring.assertion: Expected healthy-READY cost and time can outrank raw advertised GPU price.

hedging.assertion: At most one duplicate per group is launched under policy, the first authenticated healthy candidate wins singular ownership, cost/concurrency caps hold, and all losing or late-created instances are destroyed.

fleet_readiness_barrier.assertion: Historical READY events cannot satisfy the gate; all 97 current healthy roles and matching parent/fragment generations must survive the 30-second, three-round barrier.

dud_and_abort_cleanup.assertion: Duds, hedge losers, stale candidates, abort paths, and late provider creates converge to zero controller-attributable live instances.

go_gate_implication: Focused repair tests pass, but this artifact does not override the offline acquisition simulation NO_GO.
